items.summary: CFO review rejects retaining the proposed control-plane product proposal this cycle. Its operational metrics may describe throughput risk, but they do not establish financial return, savings, contribution margin, or cost-to-learn. Reconsider only after containment clears and a bounded prototype has a defined matching cost basis, approved learning threshold, and existing-record measurement plan.
